mappings.definition: Source-provided metabolizable energy; specific Atwater factors preferred, general factors fallback. Calories: metabolizable kcal; retain current approved precedence.
mappings.excluded_alternatives: Do not use 1008, kJ 1062, or application macro-energy synthesis.

mappings.definition: USDA protein, including nitrogen-based source calculations. Protein mass in g.
mappings.excluded_alternatives: Retain NC/AS derivation; do not recalculate nitrogen.

mappings.definition: Carbohydrate by difference; includes dietary fiber. Total carbohydrates under existing approved by-difference interpretation.
mappings.excluded_alternatives: 1050 carbohydrate by summation is excluded; negative values are not clamped.

mappings.definition: USDA total lipid (fat). Total fat mass in g.
mappings.excluded_alternatives: 1085 total fat (NLEA) is a distinct alternative and is excluded.

mappings.definition: USDA reported total dietary fiber aggregate (1079). Dietary fiber mass; initial conservative mapping uses 1079 only.
mappings.excluded_alternatives: 2033 AOAC 2011.25 is a method-distinct alternative; review method policy before adding it. Never sum overlapping fiber fields.

mappings.definition: USDA Sugars, Total aggregate, retaining source analytical or summed derivation. Total sugars mass, excluding a claim about added sugars.
mappings.excluded_alternatives: 2000 Total Sugars is a separate dictionary entry; exclude until an explicit equivalence/precedence policy is approved. No application sum of components.

mappings.definition: USDA Sugars, added. Added sugars mass.
mappings.excluded_alternatives: No 1235 records; never infer zero or subtract other sugars.

mappings.definition: Source-reported total saturated fatty acids aggregate. Saturated fatty acid mass.
mappings.excluded_alternatives: Do not sum individual fatty acids in the application.

mappings.definition: Source-reported total monounsaturated fatty acids aggregate. Monounsaturated fatty acid mass.
mappings.excluded_alternatives: Do not manufacture an aggregate from individual isomers.

mappings.definition: Source-reported total polyunsaturated fatty acids aggregate. Polyunsaturated fatty acid mass.
mappings.excluded_alternatives: Do not manufacture an aggregate from individual isomers.

mappings.definition: Source-reported total trans fatty acids aggregate. Total trans fatty acid mass.
mappings.excluded_alternatives: 1329/1330/1331 are partial aggregates; exclude as substitutes.

mappings.definition: Source-reported cholesterol mass. Cholesterol mass.
mappings.excluded_alternatives: Missing plant-food cholesterol remains unknown; no physiological zero fill.

mappings.definition: Elemental sodium (Na) mass. Sodium mass, not salt mass.
mappings.excluded_alternatives: No NaCl conversion.

mappings.definition: Elemental potassium (K) mass. Potassium mass.
mappings.excluded_alternatives: Do not use compound mass.

mappings.definition: Elemental calcium (Ca) mass. Calcium mass.
mappings.excluded_alternatives: Do not use compound mass.

mappings.definition: Elemental iron (Fe) mass. Iron mass.
mappings.excluded_alternatives: No bioavailability or compound conversion.

mappings.definition: Elemental magnesium (Mg) mass. Magnesium mass.
mappings.excluded_alternatives: Do not use compound mass.

mappings.definition: Elemental phosphorus (P) mass. Phosphorus mass.
mappings.excluded_alternatives: Do not use phosphate mass.

mappings.definition: Elemental zinc (Zn) mass. Zinc mass.
mappings.excluded_alternatives: Do not use compound mass.

mappings.definition: Elemental copper (Cu) mass. Copper mass.
mappings.excluded_alternatives: Preserve low-concentration decimals.

mappings.definition: Elemental manganese (Mn) mass. Manganese mass.
mappings.excluded_alternatives: Preserve low-concentration decimals.

mappings.definition: Elemental selenium (Se) mass. Selenium mass in micrograms.
mappings.excluded_alternatives: JSON µg, CSV UG, app ug denote the same unit; label normalization has factor 1, never 1000.

mappings.definition: Vitamin A expressed as retinol activity equivalents. Vitamin A in micrograms RAE.
mappings.excluded_alternatives: Exclude retinol-only, carotenoids, IU and amountless 2066 Vitamin A records. Do not infer RAE from a mass label.

mappings.definition: Vitamin C, total ascorbic acid aggregate. Vitamin C mass in mg under the USDA total-ascorbic-acid definition.
mappings.excluded_alternatives: Retain source definition and derivation.

mappings.definition: Reported vitamin D2 plus D3 mass aggregate. Vitamin D interpreted as D2+D3 mass in micrograms.
mappings.excluded_alternatives: Exclude D4 and 25-hydroxy forms; 1110 IU is unnecessary where 1114 exists.

mappings.definition: Vitamin E as alpha-tocopherol. Vitamin E interpreted as alpha-tocopherol, not summed tocopherols.
mappings.excluded_alternatives: Document interpretation; do not add beta/gamma/delta tocopherols or use an untyped IU conversion.

mappings.definition: Vitamin K1 (phylloquinone); K2 menaquinone-4 and dihydrophylloquinone are separate entries. Current application says Vitamin K without a form-qualified definition.
mappings.excluded_alternatives: No exact total-K equivalence established. Hold import until K1-only use with explicit semantics is approved; never sum incompatible forms.

mappings.definition: USDA thiamin mass. Thiamin mass in mg.
mappings.excluded_alternatives: No alternative-form synthesis.

mappings.definition: USDA riboflavin mass. Riboflavin mass in mg.
mappings.excluded_alternatives: No alternative-form synthesis.

mappings.definition: USDA niacin mass. Niacin mass, excluding tryptophan-derived niacin equivalents.
mappings.excluded_alternatives: Document niacin rather than NE; no tryptophan conversion.

mappings.definition: USDA pantothenic acid mass. Pantothenic acid mass in mg.
mappings.excluded_alternatives: No salt-mass substitution.

mappings.definition: USDA Vitamin B-6 aggregate. Vitamin B6 under the USDA reported aggregate definition.
mappings.excluded_alternatives: Do not add individual vitamers or infer equivalence.

mappings.definition: Folate expressed as dietary folate equivalents. Folate in micrograms DFE.
mappings.excluded_alternatives: 1190 absent; 1177 total folate is not DFE. Separate 1186 folic acid and 1187 food folate inputs are absent.

mappings.definition: USDA Vitamin B-12 aggregate. Vitamin B12 mass in micrograms.
mappings.excluded_alternatives: Do not substitute unrelated cobalamin activity measures.

mappings.definition: USDA total choline aggregate. Total choline mass in mg.
mappings.excluded_alternatives: Exclude betaine; do not recompute from choline metabolites.
